references.text: The same cleansing procedure with a seven-day waiting period, washing of clothes and bathing of the body for lepers who are made clean.
Parallel text about the woman's cleansing from her flow, with the same seven-day period and cleansing ritual.
Priests with a flow must wait until they are clean before they can eat of the holy offerings.
Cleansing on the seventh day with water as part of the cleansing process.
Cleansing by washing oneself in water toward evening after uncleanness.
A prophetic promise that God will sprinkle clean water over the people to cleanse them from all uncleanness.
A fountain shall be opened for the house of David for cleansing from sin and uncleanness.
Christ's blood cleanses the heart from a guilty conscience, and the body is washed with clean water - fulfillment of the cleansing rituals.
